**Finding submitted: deviation (LOL-CAP), fallback target.**

- **Responsive language:** Article XIII (p0130–p0131) is the document's only cap — verified by sweeping for "liability", "aggregate liability", "EXCEED", "consequential damages", and the Article II disclaimers (p0029, p0034–p0038) and Article XXIII termination-damages waiver (p0142).
- **Why it fails fallback:** the cap runs to Licensor only, at one half of amounts paid (well under 6 months' fees), while Licensee's liability is uncapped and additionally subject to a broad Article XII indemnity — walk-away on two grounds — with no carve-outs.
- **Cure (two surgical ops):** (i) reword (b) to make the cap mutual and based on fees paid in the 12 months preceding the claim; (ii) add a new (d) placing indemnification, confidentiality breach, gross negligence and willful misconduct outside the cap.
- **Deliberately not changed:** the (a) consequential-damages waiver stays one-sided (asymmetry favours Customer); the USD 1,000,000 floor, "paid or payable", and IP-infringement carve-out are preferred-only points noted in the rationale rather than redlined.
